lines.1: I left the bath feeling refreshed and started brushing my teeth.
lines.2: Oh, Otome's toothbrush was already set up too.
lines.4: 「Excuse me. I will squeeze in beside you.」
lines.7: 「Are you not brushing for far too little time?」
lines.9: 「Show me how you usually brush your teeth.」
lines.12: 「You are not thorough enough around the canines. Their position on the curve makes them difficult to brush.」
lines.13: 「For that area, hold the toothbrush vertically, like this.」
lines.20: 「Now for the inside surface of the rearmost teeth. How do you normally brush there?」
lines.23: 「It is difficult for the brush to reach the backs of the rear molars. That is why wisdom teeth are especially prone to cavities.」
lines.24: 「Give me the toothbrush for a moment.」
lines.26: 「Open your mouth. It need not be all the way.」
lines.28: 「Like this. Push it deep enough to reach the cheekbone.」
lines.29: Guh. She pushed the toothbrush deep into my mouth.
lines.34: My body obeyed before I could think, and I crouched.
lines.35: Otome smoothly stepped around behind me.
lines.36: 「Give me the brush again. This is how you do it.」
lines.38: 「You truly are careless. I cannot leave you unattended.」
lines.39: Had I imagined it, or did she sound a little pleased?
lines.40: Having somebody else brush my teeth left me with mixed feelings.
lines.41: It felt good, but it was embarrassing too.
lines.42: 「Do you understand how to brush them now?」
lines.44: All this commotion over a single toothbrush.
lines.45: 「I do not want to nag you. But this is to prevent cavities, so bear with me.」
